title: Roho y'Umurwayi
intro: Mu nkuru z’ubuhanuzi, hari umuntu wihanganye cyane. Banyuze mu marira n’igihe, bakomeje kugira ibyiringiro, baba urugero rudashira rwo kwiringira ubwenge bw’Imana. Ese ushobora guhishura ibanga ry’uyu muntu udacika intege?
clues: Navukiye mu muryango w'abahanuzi, ariko ikigeragezo cyanjye gikomeye cyaturutse ku mwana nakundaga cyane.
Nahawe umuburo w'ishyari nturutse mu nzozi umuhungu wanjye yangiriye, kandi nagize ubwoba bw'umutekano we.
Amaso yanjye yahindutse umweru kubera agahinda, nyamara sinigeze ntakaza ukwizera mu mbabazi za Allah.
Impumuro y'umwana wanjye wabuze yaramgezeho kure, maze menya ko kongera guhura byari byegereje.
Umuryango wanjye warapfukamye ushimira igihe iyerekwa rya kera ryasohozwaga, maze amaso yanjye arongera arahumuka.
Ni njye wahawe ishati irimo amaraso, nyuma nza guhabwa ishati yankijije amaso.

arabic: قَالَ إِنَّمَآ أَشْكُوا۟ بَثِّى وَحُزْنِىٓ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ وَأَعْلَمُ مِنَ ٱللَّهِ مَا لَا تَعْلَمُونَ
verse: He said, "I only complain of my suffering and my grief to Allāh, and I know from Allāh that which you do not know. (12:86)
